871: yet he was still not convinced, so hard was his heart.
Kabir says: the Kazi did not understand that our protector is the Lord of the universe;
ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ; ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
the soul of His servant dwells in the fourth state, beyond the three qualities, at His feet. ॥4॥1॥4॥
ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨਸੁ; ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
This soul within is neither man nor god,
nor is it called a celibate or a worshipper of Shiva;
it is neither yogi nor renunciate;
ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਇ; ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
it has no mother, nor is it anyone's son. ॥1॥
Who is it that dwells in this temple of the body?
ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ; ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
No one has reached the depth of it. ॥1॥ Rahao
It is neither householder nor ascetic,
ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਰਾਜ; ਨ ਭੀਖ ਮੰਗਾਸੀ ॥
ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਪਿੰਡੁ; ਨ ਰਕਤੂ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
it has no body, not a drop of blood;
ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ; ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਖਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
it is neither Brahmin nor Khatri. ॥2॥
It is not called a penitent or a Sheikh;
ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਵੈ; ਨ ਮਰਤਾ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
see, it is neither born nor dies.
ਇਸੁ ਮਰਤੇ ਕਉ; ਜੇ ਕੋਊ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
Whoever weeps for it, thinking it has died,
the one who weeps only loses his honour. ॥3॥
By the Guru's grace I have found the path,
and have had both birth and death erased.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ; ਇਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਅੰਸੁ ॥
Kabir says: this soul is a part of the Lord,
ਜਸ ਕਾਗਦ ਪਰ; ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਮੰਸੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
joined to Him like ink on paper that cannot be erased. ॥4॥2॥5॥
The threads of the warp are broken, the starch is used up,
the empty reeds glisten at the door,
the poor brushes are falling to pieces;
death seems to have mounted the head of this shaven-headed one. ॥1॥
This shaven-headed holy man has squandered all our wealth.
ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ; ਨਾਕ ਸਰ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The coming and going of his companions has exhausted me. ॥1॥ Rahao
He has given up all talk of shuttle and treadle, all thought of weaving;
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ; ਵਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
his mind is dyed in the Lord's Name.
There is nothing left for the children to eat,
while his shaven-headed companions go away sated every day. ॥2॥
ਇਕ ਦੁਇ ਮੰਦਰਿ; ਇਕ ਦੁਇ ਬਾਟ ॥
One or two are in the house, and one or two more on the way.
ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਾਥਰੁ; ਉਨ ਕਉ ਖਾਟ ॥
We sleep on the floor, they on the beds.
They come rubbing their heads, with holy books tied at their waists.
ਹਮ ਕਉ ਚਾਬਨੁ; ਉਨ ਕਉ ਰੋਟੀ ॥੩॥
We get parched grain to chew, they get bread. ॥3॥
Kabir says: these companions are one at heart,
and they are the support of those drowning in the sea of vice.
you too, take refuge with these holy men. ॥4॥3॥6॥
ਖਸਮੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
When her husband dies, this wife, Maya, does not weep,
for someone else becomes her keeper.
and for his enjoyments here he earns hell hereafter. ॥1॥
There is one bride, Maya, beloved of the world,
ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whom all beings and creatures want as their wife. ॥1॥ Rahao
The necklace looks beautiful on this bride's neck.
The world delights in her, but to the saint she is poison.
Adorned like a harlot, she sits waiting,
yet cursed by the saints, the poor thing wanders far from them. ॥2॥
but by the Guru's grace on them, she fears their blows.
She is the very life and breath of the faithless,
ਹਮ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਰੈ; ਤ੍ਰਖਿ ਡਾਇਣਿ ॥੩॥
but to me she appears a terrible witch. ॥3॥
ਹਮ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਬਹੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਭੇਉ ॥
I have fully understood her secret
since the Divine Guru became merciful and met me.
Kabir says: now she has been driven away from me,
and has clung to the hem of the worldly. ॥4॥4॥7॥
872: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
The house that has not the beauty of wealth,
travellers who come there go away hungry.
Its master has no contentment within.
Without the bride, Maya, the household is blamed. ॥1॥
Blessed is this bride, she is very pure;
without her, even the minds of the greatest ascetics waver. ॥1॥ Rahao
But this bride lives as the daughter of the miser.
Leaving the Lord's servants aside, she has bewitched all the world.
Standing at the door of the holy one,
she cries: I have come to your refuge, save me. ॥2॥
the anklets on her feet jingle.
ਜਉ ਲਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ; ਤਊ ਲਗੁ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
As long as there is breath in a man, she stays with him;
ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਚਲੀ; ਬੇਗਿ ਉਠਿ ਨੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
otherwise she rises and runs off at once, barefoot. ॥3॥
This bride has conquered the three worlds.
ਦਸ ਅਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ; ਤੀਰਥ ਰਸ ਕੀਆ ॥
She has bewitched the readers of the eighteen Puranas and the visitors of pilgrim places.
She has pierced Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva,
and put a ring through the noses of great emperors and kings. ॥4॥
This bride has no near or far shore; her expanse is endless.
She mingles with the five senses.
But since the vessels of my five senses have been broken,
Kabir says, by the Guru's grace I have been released from her. ॥5॥5॥8॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ; ਬਲਹਰ. ਨਾ ਠਾਹਰੈ ॥
As a house cannot stand without its beam,
so how can one cross over without the Name?
As water cannot be held without a pitcher,
so without the Guru one departs in a wretched state. ॥1॥
ਜਾਰਉ ਤਿਸੈ; ਜੁ ਰਾਮੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ॥
Let me burn the mind that does not remember the Lord,
ਤਨ ਮਨ ਰਮਤ ਰਹੈ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਤੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and stays absorbed in the field of bodily pleasures. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜੈਸੇ ਹਲਹਰ ਬਿਨਾ; ਜਿਮੀ. ਨਹੀ ਬੋਈਐ ॥
As land cannot be sown without a ploughman,
as beads cannot be strung without a thread,
as a knot cannot be tied without a loop,
so without the Guru one departs in a wretched state. ॥2॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬਾਲੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
As a child is not born without mother and father,
as clothes cannot be washed without water,
as there can be no rider without a horse,
so without the Guru the Lord's court is not reached. ॥3॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਨਹੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
As there is no dance without music,
so the Husband casts off and spurns the ill-natured bride.
Kabir says: do the one thing worth doing:
turn to the Guru, and you will not die again. ॥4॥6॥9॥
ਕੂਟਨੁ ਸੋਇ; ਜੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੂਟੈ ॥
You call the cheat a "kootan", but he too is a "kootan" who pounds his own mind.
ਮਨ ਕੂਟੈ; ਤਉ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
The one who subdues his mind escapes Death.
The one who pounds his mind again and again and tests it on the touchstone,
O people of the world, whom do you call a "kootan"?
ਸਗਲ ਬੋਲਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਹਿ; ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
All words can bear different meanings. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਨਾਚਨੁ ਸੋਇ; ਜੁ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਚੈ ॥
You call the dancer a "nachan", but he is a dancer who dances with the mind,
who is not pleased by falsehood but delights in truth,
who keeps the mind's rhythm in spiritual fervour;
the Lord Himself becomes the protector of such a dancer's mind. ॥2॥
You call the jester a "bazari", but he is a man of the bazaar who examines the bazaar of his own body,
who awakens the five corrupted senses,
and learns devotion to the Master of the nine regions;
ਤਸਕਰੁ ਸੋਇ; ਜਿ ਤਾਤਿ. ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥
You call the thief a "taskar", but he is a thief who steals envy out of his mind and harbours none,
who restrains his senses and utters the Name.
Kabir says: the one through whom I have gained such qualities,
blessed is my Divine Guru, most beautiful and wise. ॥4॥7॥10॥
873: Blessed is the Lord of the world, who sustains the earth; blessed is the Divine Guru;
blessed is the grain, by which the heart-lotus of the hungry blossoms.
ਧਨੁ ਓਇ ਸੰਤ; ਜਿਨ ਐਸੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
Blessed are the saints who have understood this;
Grain comes from the Primal Being,
ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ; ਅੰਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and the Name is repeated only after tasting grain. ॥1॥ Rahao
Repeat the Name, and cherish grain too.
With water, grain takes on a beautiful colour.
Those men who abstain from grain
lose their honour in all three worlds. ॥2॥
Those who give up grain and practise hypocrisy
are like women neither married nor widowed.
They go about telling the world that they live on milk alone,
but secretly they eat whole sweet-balls. ॥3॥
Without grain there can be no plenty;
by giving up grain the Lord is not found.
blessed is grain, eating which my mind is joined to the Master. ॥4॥8॥11॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
If one performs the horse sacrifice,
gives his weight in gold in charity,
ਤਉ. ਨ ਪੁਜਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
still these do not equal the Name and praise of the Lord.
ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਭਜੁ; ਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O my lazy mind, meditate on your Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao
If one offers rice-balls for the ancestors at Gaya,
dwells at Benares on the banks of the Asi,
and recites the four Vedas by heart, ॥2॥
if one performs all religious rites,
restrains the senses through the guru's teaching,
and keeps the six Brahminical duties, ॥3॥
and recites the dialogues of Shiva and Shakti,
O mind, give up, give up all these, which only create distance from the Lord.
Remember, remember the Lord of the universe.
Meditate, Namdev, and you will cross the world-ocean. ॥4॥1॥
As the deer runs after the sound of the hunter's bell,
ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜੇ; ਵਾ ਕੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
and gives up its life but does not let go of its attention to it, ॥1॥
so do I gaze upon the Lord.
ਰਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ; ਚਿਤੁ ਅਨਤ. ਨ ਫੇਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Forsaking the Lord, I do not turn my mind elsewhere. ॥1॥ Rahao
As the fisherman watches the fish,
as the goldsmith watches the gold he shapes, ॥2॥
as the lustful man watches another's wife,
as the gambler watches the dice he throws, ॥3॥
ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ; ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
so wherever I look, there I see the Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ; ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Namdev ever meditates on the Lord's feet. ॥4॥2॥
ਮੋ ਕਉ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇ ਰਾਮਾ; ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇ ॥
Carry me across, O Lord, carry me across.
ਮੈ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਤਰਿਬੇ. ਨ ਜਾਨਉ; ਬਾਪ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਬਾਹ ਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am Your ignorant servant and do not know how to swim; O my Father, my Lord, give me Your arm. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਨਰ ਤੇ. ਸੁਰ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਤ ਨਿਮਖ ਮੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ॥
Through the understanding taught by the True Guru, one becomes a god from a man in an instant.
ਨਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿ. ਸੁਰਗ ਕਉ ਜੀਤਿਓ; ਸੋ ਅਵਖਧ. ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
May I obtain that medicine by which one born human conquers heaven itself. ॥1॥
ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਧੂਅ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਟੇਕੇ; ਨੈਕੁ ਟਿਕਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
Wherever You placed Dhru and Narad, O Lord, place me there too.
ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਵਿਲੰਬਿ. ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਨ ਉਧਰੇ; ਨਾਮੇ ਕੀ ਨਿਜ ਮਤਿ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੩॥
With the support of Your Name countless beings have been saved; this is Namdev's firm conviction. ॥2॥3॥
874: I am in anguish without the Lord,
like the cow alone without her calf. ॥1॥
As the fish writhes without water,
ਐਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬਾਪੁਰੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
so poor Namdev writhes without the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
As when the cow's calf is let loose,
it sucks at the udder and gulps the cream, ॥2॥
so Namdev has found the Lord;
meeting the Guru, he has been shown the Unseen. ॥3॥
As the lustful man loves another's wife for pleasure,
As beings burn and suffer in the blazing sun,
ਤੈਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬਾਪੁਰੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੫॥੪॥
so poor Namdev suffers without the Lord's Name. ॥5॥4॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ; ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
Chanting the Lord's Name, all doubts are erased.
ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ; ਊਤਮ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
Take the Lord's Name; this is the highest religion.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ; ਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਹਰੀ ॥
Chanting the Lord's Name, distinctions of caste and lineage are removed.
That Lord is the blind man's stick. ॥1॥
I bow to the Lord, I bow in reverence to the Lord,
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ; ਨਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਮਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
chanting whose Name there is no pain from Death. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Lord took the life of Harnakash,
and gave Ajamal a place in heaven.
Teaching the parrot to say the Lord's Name, the courtesan was saved.
That Lord is the apple of my eye. ॥2॥
Chanting the Lord's Name, Pootna was saved,
Through remembrance Draupadi was saved from dishonour,
and Gautam's virtuous wife, turned to stone, was set free. ॥3॥
The Lord who destroyed Kesi and Kans,
gave the gift of life to the serpent Kali.
Namdev prays: such is the Lord,
meditating on whom all fear and calamity are averted. ॥4॥1॥5॥
Whoever runs after Bhairo becomes a ghost; whoever worships Sitala
rides a donkey and scatters dust. ॥1॥
As for me, I will take only the Name of the One beautiful Lord.
All other gods I will give away in exchange for it. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਕਰਤੇ; ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
The man who meditates chanting "Shiva, Shiva"
rides a bull and beats a little drum. ॥2॥
The one who worships the Great Mother
is reborn a woman instead of a man. ॥3॥
O Bhavani, you are called the Primal One,
but at the time of liberation, where do you hide? ॥4॥
O friend, through the Guru's teaching hold fast to the Lord's Name.
Namdev prays: so says the Gita too. ॥5॥2॥6॥
ਆਜੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਮੂਰਖ ਕੋ ਸਮਝਾਊ ਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Today Namdev has beheld the Lord; come, let me explain to the fool why he has not. ॥ Rahao
ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ; ਲੋਧੇ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਖਾਤੀ ਥੀ ॥
O pandit, your Gayatri, as you yourself tell, went grazing in Lodha's field;
ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਠੇਗਾ ਟਗਰੀ ਤੋਰੀ; ਲਾਂਗਤ ਲਾਂਗਤ ਜਾਤੀ ਥੀ ॥੧॥
he took a stick and broke her leg, and she went off limping. ॥1॥
ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ; ਧਉਲੇ ਬਲਦ ਚੜਿਆ ਆਵਤੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਥਾ ॥
O pandit, your great god Shiva was seen coming, riding a white bull;
ਮੋਦੀ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਖਾਣਾ ਪਾਕਾ; ਵਾ ਕਾ ਲੜਕਾ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਥਾ ॥੨॥
a meal was prepared for him in the steward's house, and he killed the steward's son. ॥2॥
875: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਰਾਮਚੰਦੁ; ਸੋ ਭੀ ਆਵਤੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਥਾ ॥
O pandit, your Ramchandra too was seen coming;
ਰਾਵਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਰਬਰ ਹੋਈ; ਘਰ ਕੀ ਜੋਇ. ਗਵਾਈ ਥੀ ॥੩॥
he fought a war with Ravan, having lost his own wife. ॥3॥
The Hindu is blind in both eyes, the Muslim in one.
Wiser than both is the one who has true spiritual wisdom.
The Hindu worships the temple, the Muslim the mosque.
ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਜਹ. ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਨ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
Namdev serves the Lord who has neither temple nor mosque. ॥4॥3॥7॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
O people of the world, meditate on the Lord, the Giver of liberation.
Without the Lord the body is wasted.
That Lord is the Giver of liberation.
That Lord is my father and mother. ॥1॥
His devotee remembers the Lord in life and remembers Him in death;
ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the servant of the Lord is ever in bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao
Remembrance of the Lord is my very life.
Meditating on the Lord, destiny has awakened on my forehead.
Serving the Lord makes one detached from the world.
I, poor as I am, have found the Lord's Name as my wealth. ॥2॥
If the One Lord shows me kindness,
what can the world do to me?
O Lord, Your devotion has erased the stigma of my caste, for I now dwell at Your door;
You alone, O Lord, can carry me across in every age. ॥3॥
Spiritual wisdom has welled up and light has dawned within.
In His mercy the Lord has made me, His lowly servant, His own.
Ravidas says: now my craving has ended;
I meditate on the Lord and serve Him alone. ॥4॥1॥
Even if one bathes at the sixty-eight pilgrim places,
and has wells and pools dug for others,
if he slanders the holy, all of it goes in vain. ॥1॥
How can the slanderer of the holy be saved?
ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਨਹੁ; ਨਰਕ ਹੀ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Know for certain that he falls into hell. ॥1॥ Rahao
Even if one bathes at Kurukshetra during an eclipse,
gives his adorned wife away in charity,
and listens to all the Simritis with his ears,
if he slanders the good, none of it is of any use. ॥2॥
Even if one offers many feasts to the idols,
and gains renown in the world by giving away land,
and harms himself to further the affairs of others,
if he slanders the good, he wanders through many births. ॥3॥
O people of the world, why do you slander the saints?
The slanderer's shop of deceit is exposed.
I have reflected thoroughly on the slanderer:
Ravidas says, the sinner has gone to hell. ॥4॥2॥11॥7॥2॥49॥ Jor
876: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth: the Maker, all-pervading, without fear, without enmity, beyond time, unborn, self-existent — realised by the Guru's grace.
ਕੋਈ ਪੜਤਾ ਸਹਸਾਕਿਰਤਾ; ਕੋਈ ਪੜੈ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
O Lord, forgetting Your Name, one reads the Prakrit scriptures, another reads the Puranas;
ਕੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ; ਲਾਗੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
one repeats a god's name on a rosary, another sits absorbed in trance.
ਅਬ ਹੀ ਕਬ ਹੀ. ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ; ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
But I know nothing of these, now or ever; I recognise only Your One Name. ॥1॥
ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰੇ; ਮੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਗਤੇ ॥
O Lord, I did not know what my state would be without Your Name.
ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨ, ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ, ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਜ. ਪਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am foolish and ignorant, O God, and have come to Your refuge; be merciful, O Master, and save my honour. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਬਹੂ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਊਭਿ ਚੜਤੁ ਹੈ; ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
Sometimes the soul soars up to the heavens, sometimes it falls to the netherworld.
ਲੋਭੀ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਥਿਰੁ. ਨ ਰਹਤੁ ਹੈ; ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
The greedy soul does not stay steady, but searches in all four directions. ॥2॥
ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ. ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ; ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਹਿ ਮਾਈ ॥
O mother, beings come into the world with death written for them, yet they make plans to live forever.
ਏਕਿ ਚਲੇ. ਹਮ ਦੇਖਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਤੀ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
O Master, before our eyes so many are departing; the fire of death is burning. ॥3॥
ਨ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਮੀਤੁ. ਨ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਭਾਈ; ਨਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਬਾਪੁ. ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
No one is anyone's friend, no one's brother, no one's father or mother.
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ; ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Nanak prays: if You grant Your Name, that alone will be our companion at the end. ॥4॥1॥
O Lord, Your light pervades all.
Wherever I look, may I see the Lord. ॥1॥
O Master, remove my ever-growing desires for life.
ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਡਿਆ; ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਉਤਰਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My mind is stuck in the blind well of Maya; how can I cross over, O Master? ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ; ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
Those within whose hearts the Lord's light becomes manifest, why would they not see Him outside too?
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਸਦਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
The Master ever takes care of them; their care is always in His mind. ॥2॥
He Himself is near, and He Himself is far.
If I meet the True Guru, the darkness departs,
877: and wherever I look, I see Him pervading. ॥3॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ. ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ; ਨੈਣੀ ਲਾਗਸਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Doubt within, and Maya without: as long as Maya's beauty pierces the eyes like an arrow,
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ; ਪਰਤਾਪਹਿਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
Nanak, the servant of servants, prays: O mortal, you will suffer greatly. ॥4॥2॥
ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ. ਕਵਨੁ ਦਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ; ਦਰਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਦਰੁ. ਕਵਨੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
The place where You dwell, O Lord, how can it be described? Who can find that door within the doors?
ਜਿਸੁ ਦਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਫਿਰਾ ਉਦਾਸੀ; ਸੋ ਦਰੁ. ਕੋਈ ਆਇ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
For that door I wander in longing; if only someone would come and tell me of it. ॥1॥
How can the world-ocean be crossed?
While living, one cannot die to the self. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ. ਰੋਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ; ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ. ਦੁਇ ਪਟ ਜੜੇ ॥
Pain is the door, anger the guard; hope and anxiety are its two shutters.
ਮਾਇਆ ਜਲੁ ਖਾਈ. ਪਾਣੀ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ; ਸਤ ਕੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
Maya is the moat around it, filled with the water of vice, and in that water the house is built; within it the all-pervading Lord sits on the seat of truth. ॥2॥
ਕਿੰਤੇ ਨਾਮਾ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ; ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ, ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
You have so many Names, yet Your limit is not known; O Lord, there is none equal to You.
ਊਚਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ. ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ; ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
There is no need to speak aloud; stay within your own mind. He Himself knows and Himself does all. ॥3॥
ਜਬ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ; ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
As long as there is hope, there is anxiety; how then can one meditate on the One?
ਆਸਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ; ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੪॥
When one stays free of hope while living amid hopes, then, Nanak, one meets the One Lord. ॥4॥
In this way the ocean is crossed,
and in this way one dies while living. ॥1॥ Second Rahao ॥3॥
ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਖੀ. ਮੇਰੀ ਸਿੰਙੀ; ਬਾਜੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
Fixing my attention on the Lord who hears the whole world is my call; beholding Him within is the horn I blow at His door.
ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ. ਮੰਗਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ; ਭੀਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੇ ॥੧॥
Making myself a worthy vessel is the begging bag on my shoulder, so that I may receive the alms of the Name. ॥1॥
O yogi, my Gorakh is ever awake.
ਗੋਰਖੁ ਸੋ. ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ; ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My Gorakh is the One who created the world, and took no time in creating it. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪਵਣਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਾਖੇ; ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਏ ॥
He bound the breath of life within water and air, and made the sun and moon the chief lamps.
ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੀਨੀ; ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰੇ ॥੨॥
He gave the earth to live and die on; yet beings have forgotten so many kindnesses. ॥2॥
ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ; ਪੀਰ ਪੁਰਸ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
There are so many siddhas, seekers, yogis, wandering ascetics, pirs and holy men;
ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਾ. ਤ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖਾ; ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
if I meet them, I will only sing the Lord's praises with them, and my mind will serve Him. ॥3॥
ਕਾਗਦੁ ਲੂਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਗੇ; ਪਾਣੀ ਕਮਲੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
As paper and salt kept in ghee do not dissolve, as the lotus stays unharmed in water,
ਐਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
so, servant Nanak, the devotees stay united with the Lord; what can Death do to them? ॥4॥4॥
the true renunciate keeps the five vices under control and does not waver.
He keeps to such a way of life; this is his yoga.
He crosses over himself and carries all his family across. ॥1॥
He alone is a true renunciate who attains such understanding
that day and night he stays absorbed in the trance where no thought of Maya arises. ॥1॥ Rahao
His alms is to live in love, devotion and the fear of God.
With these alms he is sated by priceless contentment.
Becoming one with the Lord, he makes that absorption his yogic seat.
He fixes his mind on the true Name; this is his trance. ॥2॥
listen, Machhindra, these are the marks of the renunciate:
amid hopes he lives free of hope,
and so, Nanak, he surely attains the Creator. ॥3॥
Nanak prays: he hears and tells the praises of the unreachable Lord,
and merges himself in the Guru, joining disciple to Guru.
He eats the food and the medicine of the Guru's teaching,
878: and so understands the truth of the six schools of garb. ॥4॥5॥
ਹਮ ਡੋਲਤ. ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਪ ਭਰੀ ਹੈ; ਪਵਣੁ ਲਗੈ ਮਤੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
I tremble: my boat is laden with sins, and the storm of Maya is blowing; I fear it may sink.
ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਿਧ ਭੇਟਣ ਕਉ ਆਏ; ਨਿਹਚਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
Casting off shame I have come to your door to meet the Lord; O Guru, surely grant me the gift of His praise. ॥1॥
O Guru, Saviour, carry me across.
ਦੇਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ; ਹਉ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Grant me devotion to the perfect, imperishable Lord; I am a sacrifice to you. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਅਰੁ ਜੰਗਮ; ਏਕੁ ਸਿਧੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
They alone are true siddhas, seekers, yogis and wandering ascetics, who meditate on the One Perfect Lord.
ਪਰਸਤ ਪੈਰ ਸਿਝਤ ਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
Those who receive the Guru's Word touch the Master's feet and succeed in life. ॥2॥
ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
I know no chanting, austerity, discipline or ritual; I only repeat Your Name, O God.
ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਟਿਓ; ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੬॥
Nanak, the one who meets the Guru meets the Transcendent Lord; through the true Word his account is settled. ॥3॥6॥
In this human life, merge your attention in the Lord.
Make your body light as a raft, by which you can cross over.
Within you is the divine fire; keep it safe,
and the lamp of wisdom will burn day and night without fail. ॥1॥
Float such a lamp upon the water,
ਜਿਤੁ ਦੀਵੈ; ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by which you will understand everything. ॥1॥ Rahao
If the clay is good understanding,
the Lord accepts the lamp made from it.
Make the wheel from good conduct, and shape the lamp on it;
it will stay with you here and hereafter. ॥2॥
When He Himself casts His glance of grace,
a rare one, turning to the Guru, understands.
In that heart the lamp burns steadily;
it does not drown in water nor can it be put out.
Float such a lamp upon the water. ॥3॥
However the wind of vice blows, it does not waver or go out;
by its light the Lord seated on the throne of the heart is seen.
Be one a Khatri, Brahmin, Shudra or Vaish,
or of thousands of castes beyond counting,
To bow before You, O Lord, is to cherish Your Name;
the true offering is Your praise, which wins a place to sit in Your presence.
When one lives in service and contentment and offers prayer,
then the Lord hears, calls him, and seats him near Himself. ॥1॥
such is the Lord's court, and such is the True Lord Himself. ॥1॥ Rahao
The treasure of Your Name is received by the one on whom Your grace and blessing fall.
I, a beggar, long that You will give it to me.
Love for You comes into that vessel of the heart alone
in which You Yourself have placed its worth from the start. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ; ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
The One who created all, Himself plays this play of love.
He Himself places the worth of His Name in hearts.
Through the Guru the Sovereign Lord becomes manifest within;
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
then one knows that, apart from Him, no one comes and no one goes. ॥3॥
ਲੋਕੁ ਧਿਕਾਰੁ ਕਹੈ, ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ; ਮਾਗਤ ਮਾਨੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
People curse the beggar; by begging, honour is not obtained.
ਸਹ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ. ਦਰ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ; ਤੈ ਤਾ. ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥
But, O Master, You Yourself have made me speak of Your generosity and the ways of Your door, from which none goes empty. ॥4॥8॥
ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੂੰਦ. ਬੂੰਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ; ਕਵਣੁ ਬੁਝੈ. ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
As drops are in the ocean and the ocean in the drops, so beings live in the Lord and He in them; who understands this and knows the way?
ਉਤਭੁਜ ਚਲਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਚੀਨੈ; ਆਪੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
He Himself creates the play of the sources of life and watches it, and He Himself knows its essence. ॥1॥
879: Rare is the one who reflects on such wisdom;
ਤਿਸ ਤੇ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
through it come liberation and the supreme state. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਦਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੈਣਿ. ਰੈਣਿ ਮਹਿ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ; ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
Night merges into day and the sun into night; so too heat and cold; all is His play.
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣੈ; ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
No one else knows His state and extent; without the Guru this understanding does not come. ॥2॥
ਪੁਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਰਿ. ਨਾਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਰਖਾ; ਬੂਝਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
Woman is born of man and man of woman; understand this, O knower of God.
ਧੁਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ. ਧਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
The one who turns to the Guru fixes his attention on the Word of praise, and in that attention comes to know the Lord, whose story is indescribable. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ. ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ; ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
The light is in their minds, and their minds are absorbed in the light; their five senses, like brothers of one Guru, cease wandering.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ; ਜਿਨ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੯॥
Nanak, I am ever a sacrifice to those who have fixed their attention on the One Word. ॥4॥9॥
When the Lord God showed mercy,
That soul-handmaid became dear to the Lord,
who became wise through the Guru's Word. ॥1॥
ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
That servant of the Lord is pleasing to the Lord God,
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਲਾਜ ਛੋਡਿ. ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who, giving up worldly shame, worships Him day and night and sings His praises. ॥1॥ Rahao
Within, the deep sweet sound of unceasing music resounds.
My mind is absorbed in the relish of the Lord.
Through the perfect Guru the True One has merged within me.
Through the Guru I have found the Lord, the Primal Being. ॥2॥
All the horns of the yogis and the Vedas are contained in the Guru's Word,
for the one whose mind is dyed in the Lord.
In that state are all pilgrimages, fasts and austerities.
The one who meets the Guru, the Lord carries across. ॥3॥
Where self-conceit is gone, fear runs away.
That servant is absorbed in the Guru's feet.
The Guru, the True Guru, has ended his wandering,
Nanak says, the one whom he has joined to the Word. ॥4॥10॥
The yogi who goes begging for food and clothes
burns here in the fire of wretched hunger and suffers hereafter.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ. ਨਹੀ ਲੀਨੀ; ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
He did not take the Guru's teaching, and by evil thinking lost his honour.
Only a rare one, through the Guru's teaching, earns devotion. ॥1॥
The way of the true yogi is to dwell in the home of poise.
ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਏਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਭੀਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
With an equal eye he sees the One Lord in all, and joined to the Word he is sated by the alms of love. ॥1॥ Rahao
The body is a little cart drawn by five oxen, the senses.
As long as the Lord's power is in it, all its honour remains.
When the axle breaks, the cart topples headlong,
its timbers scatter, and it rots beneath its own load. ॥2॥
O yogi, reflect on the Guru's Word.
ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਣਾ; ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੀ ॥
Learn to bear pain and pleasure, grief and separation alike.
Make the Name, reflected on through the Guru's Word, your food.
Meditate on the Formless Lord, and the wall of your body will stand firm against vice. ॥3॥
The one who has made poise his woollen waistband is free of the bonds of Maya.
Through the Guru's Word he has overcome lust and anger.
ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
Staying in the refuge of the Lord and the Guru, he wears the earrings within the mind.
Nanak, through the Lord's devotion His servants cross over. ॥4॥11॥
880: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Everyone says that in the Golden Age, truth prevailed,
and in every home there was devotion through the Guru;
that in the Golden Age the bull of Dharma stood on four feet.
But a rare one, turning to the Guru, reflects and understands that even then devotion came through the Guru. ॥1॥
In all four ages, glory comes through the Name.
ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੈ. ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever is attached to the Name is liberated, but without the Guru no one receives the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
In the Silver Age, it is said, one power of Dharma was taken away,
hypocrisy prevailed, and people thought the Lord far away.
But the one who, turning to the Guru, understands,
knows that peace comes only when the Name dwells within. ॥2॥
In the Brass Age, it is said, people fell into duality,
and strayed in doubt, seeing two.
In the Brass Age, Dharma stood on two feet.
But one who turns to the Guru implants the Name firmly within. ॥3॥
In the Iron Age, it is said, only one power of Dharma remains.
ਇਕ ਪੈਰਿ ਚਲੈ; ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
It walks on one foot, and attachment to Maya increases.
Attachment to Maya is pitch darkness.
But the one who meets the True Guru is saved through the Name. ॥4॥
ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ; ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
In all ages the One Lord alone is eternal.
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਚੁ; ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
The True One is in all; there is no other.
In the heart where His true praise dwells, there is true peace.
But only through the Guru does one utter the Name. ॥5॥
ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ; ਨਾਮੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
In all ages, the Name is the most exalted.
A rare one, turning to the Guru, understands this.
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ; ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
Whoever meditates on the Lord's Name is His devotee.
ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ; ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥੧॥
Nanak, in every age, glory comes through the Name. ॥6॥1॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਜੇ ਵਡਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
If one is fortunate, if one's great destiny awakens, then one meditates on the Lord's Name.
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ. ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
Repeating the Name, one finds peace in the Name, and stays absorbed in the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
O mortal, turning to the Guru, ever practise devotion.
ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ. ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The heart is enlightened, the attention is fixed, and through the Guru's teaching one merges in the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ; ਬਹੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
The Lord's virtues are diamonds, jewels, gems and rubies; He has filled the ocean of every heart with them.
ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ, ਵਡ ਮਸਤਕਿ; ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ, ਕਢਿ ਕਢਿ ਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
The one on whose forehead great destiny is written draws them out through the Guru's teaching. ॥2॥
ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵੇਹਰੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ; ਗੁਰਿ. ਕਾਢਿ ਤਲੀ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
The Lord's Name is a jewel, a gem, a ruby; the Guru has drawn it out and shown it on one's palm.
ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ. ਨਹੀ ਲੀਆ; ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਓਲੈ. ਲਾਖੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
But the unfortunate self-willed has not taken it; for him the treasure lies hidden behind a blade of straw. ॥3॥
ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਤਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
If destiny written by the Lord awakens on the forehead, the True Guru joins one to His service.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਪਾਵੈ; ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
Nanak, such a one finds the jewels and gems; blessed, blessed is he who finds the Lord through the Guru's teaching. ॥4॥1॥
ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
Meeting the Lord's servants there is bliss; they recite the Lord's sublime praise.
ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਲਿ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
All the filth of evil thinking is removed; joining the holy congregation, one gains understanding. ॥1॥
